summary: SOS Limited filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent: current report on Form 8-K) disclosing a September 24, 2026 securities purchase agreement with certain non-US persons under Regulation S for 40,000,000 Class A ordinary shares at $0.30 per share, raising approximately $12 million. Net proceeds fund data center development, working capital and general corporate purposes. Closing conditions include NYSE approval of the supplemental listing application and accuracy of representations. This is a routine private placement of equity, an ordinary capital-raising financing rather than a special situation; no board recommendation, advisor, premium, or deal protections are stated. Watch dilution and NYSE listing approval timing.
